system.description: Marksmen project force accurately across the battlefield. They may be archers, snipers, gunslingers, siege specialists, or other combatants who rely on distance, precision, and deliberate target selection.
system.benefit: Gain one additional Ballistics Expertise and two additional Ballistics Combat Cards. If this Distinction is acquired later, instead increase Ballistics to a minimum of Rank 2, then gain one additional Ballistics Expertise and four additional Ballistics Combat Cards.

origin.name: Split Focus
origin.text: You may maintain two Locks at once. If you would establish Lock on a third creature, choose which existing Lock ends.
